title: dortmanna orizabae
intro: Dortmanna orizabae, commonly known as Mexican Oregano, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is native to Mexico and Central America, and is valued for its aromatic leaves that are used as a flavoring agent in various traditional dishes. The health benefits of Dortmanna orizabae include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of the plant include antimicrobial, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids.
